summary: get_url downloads files over HTTP, HTTPS or FTP directly on the managed host, honoring proxy env vars unless overridden. In check mode it only does a HEAD request, and Windows needs win_get_url.
questions: How do I download a file onto a remote server with Ansible?
Does get_url download on the controller or the target?
How do I make get_url bypass a proxy?
Why does get_url report changed in check mode?
How do I download files on Windows hosts?

answer_card.title: Download files with get_url
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.get_url` downloads from HTTP/HTTPS/FTP **on the target host**, which needs direct access.
- Honors `<protocol>_proxy` env vars; override with task `environment` or `use_proxy: false`. Redirects can switch HTTP→HTTPS, so set both proxies.
- `--check` does a HEAD request only and may report an incorrect changed status.
- Windows: use `ansible.windows.win_get_url`.
